title: Raised Cosine Receive Filter
text: 使用升余弦 FIR 滤波器应用匹配滤波，输入 1 路、输出 1 路；按 {Rounding mode} 指定定点运算的舍入模式；{Filter shape} 指定滤波器形状 Square、{Filter span in symbols} 指定滤波器跨度（以符号为单位）、{Input samples per symbol} 指定每个符号的输入样本数、{Decimation factor} 指定输入信号的抽取因子、{Decimation offset} 指定抽取偏移（以样本为单位）、{Linear amplitude filter gain} 指定线性滤波器增益、{Input processing} 指定输入处理控制 Columns as channels、{Rate options} 指定模块处理速率 Enforce single-rate、{Export filter coefficients to workspace} 指定导出滤波器系数、{Coefficient variable name} 指定系数变量名称、{View Filter Response} 打开滤波器可视化工具、{Saturate on integer overflow} 指定定点运算的溢出模式、{Coefficients} 指定系数数据类型、{Product output} 指定乘积输出数据类型、{Accumulator} 指定累加器数据类型、{Output} 输出数据类型、{Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} 防止定点工具覆盖数据类型 也按实例取值；{Rolloff factor} 指定滚降因子，按实例取值。

ports.name: In
ports.summary: 输入信号 column vector | matrix

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: 输出信号 column vector | matrix

params.name: Filter shape
params.values: 滤波器形状 Square root (default) | Normal

params.name: Filter span in symbols
params.values: 滤波器跨度（以符号为单位） 10 (default) | even positive integer

params.name: Input samples per symbol
params.values: 每个符号的输入样本数 8 (default) | integer greater than 1

params.name: Decimation factor
params.values: 输入信号的抽取因子 8 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Decimation offset
params.values: 抽取偏移（以样本为单位） 0 (default)

params.name: Linear amplitude filter gain
params.values: 线性滤波器增益 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Input processing
params.values: 输入处理控制 Columns as channels (frame based) (default) | Elements as channels (sample based)

params.name: Rate options
params.values: 模块处理速率 Enforce single-rate processing (default) | Allow multirate processing

params.name: Export filter coefficients to workspace
params.values: 导出滤波器系数 off (default) | on

params.name: View Filter Response
params.values: 打开滤波器可视化工具 button

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: 定点运算的舍入模式 Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: 定点运算的溢出模式 off (default) | on

params.name: Coefficients
params.values: 系数数据类型 Inherit: Same word length as input (default) | fixdt(1,16) | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Product output
params.values: 乘积输出数据类型 Inherit: Same as input (default) | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: 累加器数据类型 Inherit: Same as product output (default) | Inherit: Same as input | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Output
params.values: 输出数据类型 Inherit: Same as accumulator (default) | Inherit: Same as input | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: 防止定点工具覆盖数据类型 off (default) | on
